Data.description: Primary output Shapefile containing road segments intersected with multi-ring disaster buffers (100m, 200m, 300m, 400m). Each feature includes the original road attributes plus distance_m and ring_label fields indicating which buffer zone the road segment falls within. Total: 16 road segments across 4 buffer rings.
Supporting Shapefile containing the four concentric multi-ring buffer polygons (100m, 200m, 300m, 400m) dissolved from the disaster area polygons. Used for visualization reference of impact zones.
